district_name: Slate Valley Unified Union School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(4)(F) inventory: Slate Valley Unified Union School District, a unified union district that is its own supervisory district (member towns: Benson, Castleton, Fair Haven, Hubbardton, Orwell, West Haven). Operates PK-12.
Slate Valley Unified Union School District (official site).

board.org_name: Slate Valley Unified Union School Board
board.post_note: Slate Valley UUSD: eighteen directors, residency allocated three per member town (Benson, Castleton, Fair Haven, Hubbardton, Orwell, West Haven), elected district-wide on a comingled Australian ballot (modified at-large, Articles of Agreement Art. 9). Four seats are district-published open seats (Benson 1, Orwell 1, West Haven 2).

sources.note: Slate Valley UUSD board page (official, fetched 2026-10-22): the full roster by town with a published "Term Expiration: FY20xx" per seat -- Beaumont-Stannard FY2027, King FY2029 (Benson); Belden FY2028, Finnegan FY2029, Traverse FY2027 (Castleton); Hier FY2029, Casey FY2027, Stanton FY2028 (Fair Haven); Bravo FY2027, Reinke FY2028, Denbeaux FY2027 (Hubbardton); Cousineau FY2028, Stone FY2027 (Orwell); Hertzberg FY2029 (West Haven) -- and four seats the district itself labels open (Benson 1, Orwell 1, West Haven 2). Under the Articles of Agreement Art. 10, terms expire at the March annual meeting, so FY20xx is minted as end 20xx. The Articles (Art. 9) establish the model verbatim -- 18 members, three per town, "Voters in member towns vote on the same slate of candidates" with comingled Australian ballots -- modified at-large (the "Modified Unified" styling in some AOE lists traces to never-triggered contingency articles; all six towns approved in 2017).
